item.text: {"counterevidence":["The current capacity snapshot is not stale: the latest posted capacity data are 17.18 hours old versus a 30-hour stale threshold.","The Segment 307 and Segment 399 snapshot alerts compare different gas days and nomination cycles, so their before/after changes are descriptive rather than like-for-like.","The operator states that operationally available capacity and scheduled quantity can differ because of netting, confirmation, outages, and other operating adjustments."],"facts":[{"claim":"The authoritative alert ledger records a worsened forecast for Segment 530 BH: operating capacity changed from 1.55 million to 905,000 Dth/day, a 645,000 Dth/day (41.6%) decrease, for changed periods from September 7 through October 11. This is a report revision, not proof of a physical-flow change.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932512717694000:4e5308a6b60198988cebfe87c90c7936ec29248dea254a2e2949d8b71262ebc6","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"]},{"claim":"The alert ledger records an emergent-repair notice at Station 563 near Centerville, Tennessee, affecting Segment 860 BH. The notice said up to an additional 315,000 Dth could be affected and that certain increases were at risk; it also said previously scheduled volumes would not be curtailed. Subsequent capacity data are still required to confirm the operating effect.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_critical:1788110122419257000:5c924dc6c23dab467c649f8808dc8af00af0e929cc7dc5c389521b9eec637518","km_tgp_notice_detail:1788110156344773000:f6e560a11a28f7db622d566fd415c012ffc4e7a8baa3d17f365651da6e2b059d"]},{"claim":"For the August 30 Evening Cycle, the restriction notice lists limits on nominated increases at multiple segments, including Segment 530 BH, Segment 860 BH, Segment 307 BH, Segment 399 FH, and Segment 245 FH. Final volumes may change through system balancing or confirmation reductions.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_critical:1788110122419257000:5c924dc6c23dab467c649f8808dc8af00af0e929cc7dc5c389521b9eec637518","km_tgp_notice_detail:1788110129332263000:562ccbf385a4895a751cd49caec7cf58657ea6f6cc7207626d7c1e9fda2093e3"]},{"claim":"The current segment-capacity source supports conditional transport analysis but is not measured flow. This is system context, not attribution to any TGP event.","evidence_ids":["eia_wngsr:1788115874039669000:c7dd258cb0915a825acbed60129cdeb5e37aaf8e0ebe0021c97414369d461469"]}],"glossary":[{"definition":"A unit of natural-gas energy; here, capacities and scheduled quantities are expressed per day.","term":"Dth/day"},{"definition":"Transportation capacity the pipeline makes available for scheduling. It is not measured physical flow.","term":"Operationally available capacity"},{"definition":"A scheduled transportation quantity. The operator reports it as net directional quantity, which is not the same as measured flow.","term":"Scheduled quantity"},{"definition":"The pipeline's named directional convention: FH maps to TD1 and BH maps to TD2 in the supplied transport assessments.","term":"FH/BH and TD1/TD2"}],"headline":"TGP has several confirmed notices and revised outage forecasts; the strongest near-term research items are conditional transportation-capacity shortfalls, not confirmed flow or price events.","missing_data":["Future nominations, rerouting, confirmations, and actual physical flows for each planned outage period.","Licensed regional basis observations and an exact TGP-leg-to-contract mapping.","Detail text and subsequent capacity confirmation for Notices 403833 and 403852.","Weather, production, measured-flow, and futures observations."],"overall_confidence":"medium","plain_english_summary":"The packet confirms new TGP restrictions and outage-report revisions, including a large future capacity reduction on Segment 530. The supplied transport assessments identify several planned periods where the current scheduled quantity would exceed forecast operating capacity if it did not change. Those are conditional planning scenarios, not evidence of curtailment, actual flow loss, or a price outcome.","watch_items":[{"confidence":"medium","confirmation_needed":["Updated nominations and capacity postings near September 14–20.","Evidence of rerouting, confirmations, or curtailment.","A mapped regional market instrument before assessing any price channel."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"],"invalidation":["The planned outage is revised, cancelled, or operated at a higher capacity.","Scheduled quantity falls to or below the 725,000 Dth/day forecast operating capacity.","Rerouting absorbs the scheduled quantity without restriction."],"market_channel":"transport","research_status":"research_scenario","scenario":"For Station 860 / Segment 548 BH in TD2, September 14–20 forecast operating capacity is 725,000 Dth/day versus a captured scheduled quantity of 1,393,684 Dth/day. If that schedule were unchanged, the calculated conditional scheduled shortfall is 668,684 Dth/day. This is not physical flow, confirmed curtailment, or a price prediction.","title":"Station 860 / Segment 548 BH planned capacity constraint"},{"confidence":"medium","confirmation_needed":["Updated nominations and capacity postings near September 7–20.","Evidence of rerouting, confirmations, or curtailment.","A mapped regional market instrument before assessing any price channel."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"],"invalidation":["The planned outage is revised, cancelled, or operated above the 220,000 Dth/day forecast.","Scheduled quantity falls to or below 220,000 Dth/day.","Rerouting absorbs the scheduled quantity without restriction."],"market_channel":"transport","research_status":"research_scenario","scenario":"For Station 313 Discharge / Segment 399 FH in TD1, the September 7–13 and September 14–20 assessments use forecast operating capacity of 220,000 Dth/day against a captured scheduled quantity of 707,875 Dth/day. The conditional scheduled shortfall is 487,875 Dth/day if the schedule is unchanged.","title":"Station 313 / Segment 399 FH planned capacity constraint"},{"confidence":"medium","confirmation_needed":["Updated nominations and capacity postings near October 5–11.","Confirmation that the planned operating-capacity reduction remains in effect.","A mapped regional market instrument before assessing any price channel."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"],"invalidation":["Forecast operating capacity is revised above the captured schedule.","Scheduled quantity falls to or below 695,000 Dth/day.","Rerouting absorbs the scheduled quantity without restriction."],"market_channel":"transport","research_status":"research_scenario","scenario":"For Station 307 / Segment 307 BH in TD2, October 5–11 forecast operating capacity is 695,000 Dth/day versus a captured scheduled quantity of 1,018,983 Dth/day. The calculated conditional scheduled shortfall is 323,983 Dth/day if the schedule is unchanged.","title":"Station 307 / Segment 307 BH planned capacity constraint"}],"why_it_matters":"Capacity reductions can constrain transportation options when scheduled quantities remain high. Here, the loaded evidence supports monitoring conditional transport shortfalls and notice updates only; it does not establish a local price impact or a trade implication."}
